title: Zainab ne kaha roke abbas kab aaoge
body:
zainab ney kaha rookar abbas kab aapogey (2)
cheen thi hai meri chaadar (2)
abbas kab aagoogey
zainab ne kaha rookey abbas se kab aaoogey (2)
1)athara baras walaa akber bhi gaya maraa
athara baras wala akber bhi gaya maara
seeney pa seena khaakar (2)
abbas se kab aaoogey
zainab ne kaha rookey —————-(2)
2)pani ke avez  paya ek teeer sitam ran mai
pani ka oooz paya ek teer sitam ran mai
shahmaahe ali asger abbas kab aoogey (2)
abbas se kab aaogey
zainab ne kaha rookar abbas —————(2)
3)abbas se merey bhai ek hashar hai maqtal main
abbas se merey bhai ek hashr hai maqtal main
kattaa hai sarey sarwar abbas se kab aaoogey (2)
abbas se kab aaoogey
zainab ney kaha rookar (2)
4)qaimai bhi jaaley saarey asbaab lute saare
qaimai bhi jaaley saarey asbaab lute saare
kya sootey hoo darya par (2)
abbas kab aaoogey
zainab ne kaha rookey —————(2)
5)dehkho toh merey bhaiya keecha hain laaiino ney
dehkho toh merey bhai keecha hain laaiino ney
abid ka merey bistar abbas se kab aapogey (2)
abbas se kab aaogey
zainab ney kahaa rookar abbas se kab aaogey(2)
6)dehkho toh zara aake masoom sakina ke
dehko toh zara aakey masoom sakina ko
kaano se cheeney goohar (2)
abbas kab aaoogey
zainab ne kaha rookar aabs kab aaoogey (2)
7)zaliim ke a sitam seh kar duniya se chaali aaqqaar
zaliim ka sitam seh kar duniya se chali aaqqar
bhai kiii merii dukhatar (2)
abbas se kab aaaogey
zainab ne kaha rookar abbas se kab aaogey(2)
8)be parda khadi hoon maain darbaarey sitamgar main
be parda khadi hoon main darbarey sitamgar mai
sar par na rahi  chaadar (2)
abbas kab aaoogey
zainab ney kaha rookar abbas se kab aaogey
9)daam goot tha hai bachoon ka zinaan ke andey reeh main
daam goot tha hai bacchoon ka zindaan ke andey reeh main
chuda waaa ooo haamey aaakar (2)
abbas se kab aaoogey
zainab ney kaha rookar abbas se kab aaogey
10)sahil ka hai ye noha awwaz ye ghazi ki
sahil ka hai ye noha awaaz ye ghazi ki
aye jaaney diley haider (2)
abbas kab aaoogey
zainab ne kaha rookar abbas se kab aaogey
